remarks: Easy one-level living meets thoughtful updates in this inviting 4-bedroom, 2-bath ranch, privately set on 1.5 wooded acres in central Wilton. The light-filled interior features hardwood floors, a welcoming living room with fireplace, and a streamlined kitchen with abundant cabinetry, stainless-steel appliances, and generous prep space. Four bedrooms offer flexibility for guests, work, or hobbies, while two full baths include a beautifully tiled walk-in shower. A screened porch brings the outdoors in and opens to a newly leveled, fully fenced backyard with a new stone patio-an ideal setting for dining, recreation, or quiet evenings surrounded by nature. The bright walk-out lower level adds valuable bonus space and features a new sliding door. Major improvements include conversion from oil to propane with a high-efficiency wall-mounted boiler; upgraded 200-amp electrical service; whole-house surge protection; hardwired smoke and carbon monoxide detectors; generator hookup; and water filtration, softening, and reverse-osmosis drinking water. The chimney was professionally cleaned, lined, repaired, and fitted with a new cap, while extensive tree trimming and cabling further enhance the grounds. An attached two-car garage completes this appealing home, Location is key, and this property delivers in that department as well. Situated conveniently close to town, you'll have easy access to all the amenities, shopping, dining and proximity to Wilton's award-winning schools.
